add_definitions(
    -DCOM_NO_WINDOWS_H)

spec2def(wuapi.dll wuapi.spec)

add_idl_reg_objects(wuapi registry wuapi_tlb.idl)

# wuapi.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/wuapi-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
# Generated inputs those compiles read, ordered before them.
add_library(wuapi_shims OBJECT downloader.c installer.c main.c searcher.c session.c systeminfo.c updates.c)
target_link_libraries(wuapi_shims PRIVATE uuid wine wine_dll_register wine_dll_canunload wuguid oldnames libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module_fixme(wuapi_shims) # CORE-5743: No CONST_VTABLE
add_dependencies(wuapi_shims stdole2)
set(WUAPI_REUSED
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/dll/win32/wuapi/wuapi_tlb_r.o)
add_cargo_module(wuapi wuapi-cargo wuapi.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS wuapi_shims wuapi_r ${WUAPI_REUSED} psdk uuid_sources)
